symptom: An attribute used through a microflow's own local variable in an expression — `$One/Title` after `retrieve $One from E`, `$New/Title` after `create`, `$Item/Title` inside a loop over a retrieved list — was in no reference, so MDL108 passed `alter entity E drop attribute Title` and `mx check` then reported CE0117. The first fix (#2469) resolved only parameters and said so.
cause: resolvePath looked a `$variable` up only in the document's parameters. A retrieve (RetrieveAction.RetrieveSource DatabaseRetrieveSource.Entity + ResultVariableName), a create (CreateChangeAction.Entity + VariableName) and a loop (LoopSource IterableList ListVariableName/VariableName) each state the variable's entity in the stored document.
insight: **A name given two entities is dropped, not resolved to the last one.** Mendix forbids a duplicate variable name inside one flow, but the walk reads the whole document and cannot tell scopes apart, so a name declared with two entities is removed from the scope rather than guessed: a guess is an edge to the wrong attribute, which is worse than a missing edge because it makes a safe drop look unsafe and an unsafe one look safe on the other entity. A loop item is resolved after every declaration is known, because the list's retrieve can sit after the loop in document order. A retrieve over an association and a data view's object are still unresolved.
